clock_rule: For each selected original filing, verify accession, issuer, raw SHA-256 and SGML ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME against the saved source inventory. Interpret the SGML header both as America/New_York civil time and as fixed EST, take the later UTC instant, and assign the first actual Qlib daily session strictly after the acceptance calendar date at 09:46 America/New_York. Require decision at least 12 hours after the later UTC interpretation, within 7 calendar days, and inside the frozen Qlib calendar. Do not backdate NVDA 2014 May 8 outlook to the May 6 preliminary earnings release.
interpretation: This is a conservative date-level timing screen, not proof of exact first public availability. The SEC says it has no timestamp for first website availability and does not guarantee the acceptance-to-public lag. A numeric guidance vector and any model/account need separate frozen source-semantic and information gates.
stop: Stop on any source identity, NAS receipt, Qlib manifest, calendar or timing-margin mismatch. Preserve every selected event and mark unknown or out_of_snapshot; do not impute unavailable dates.
